artist_delivery_standard.required: Each counted work must be a distinct canonical object with an actually viewed, legally displayable real image, original Chinese introduction and authoritative metadata/source/license evidence.
artist_delivery_standard.selection: Prioritize art-historical significance and coverage of key periods/themes/techniques using museum, scholarly catalogue and retrospective evidence; image availability alone does not establish representativeness.
artist_delivery_standard.priority: Within the existing seven-category rotation, complete artists below20 first. Audit representativeness and image/text quality for artists already over20 before moving to the next artist.
artist_delivery_standard.exceptions: Document verified surviving corpus limits, attribution uncertainty and image-rights gaps. Never pad with details, duplicates, workshop copies or unavailable originals. Link-only records do not count as image-complete.
artist_delivery_standard.auditStatus: Hilma20（核心实验1906—1915；生涯覆盖待补、上线未过）；Monet20；Leonardo2；Caravaggio8。其他旧条目须逐项审查，不按历史记录数自动验收；顾恺之亲笔目标有存世规模例外。
